claims: The actual joint history/observation law factors through the literal instrument kernel. Current and next normalized states are specified measurable accessible history maps, and their positive-density posterior relation is separate from the desired CE conclusion.

The true density times accessible posterior equals the unnormalized operator branch AE, including zero mass where strict cone mass forces the branch zero. Weighted-response integrability is derived from actual weighted operator integrability and the normalized-base bound.

Ordinary CE uniqueness derives the actual vector moment and action-gated row mean at each dependent time relative to the exact recorded-history filtration. Neither CE identity nor a confidence conclusion is an input certificate field.
Integrating the literal finite observation-basis expansion derives M=W C. The known actual invertible W reconstructs the true coefficient operators and their coordinate matrices.

Every fitted moment row is the literal P81 ridge estimate from the observed action-gated state design and accessible next-state response. Actual P81 Gaussian-mixture Good events are intersected using the unchanged finite action/moment/row prospective budget, with no row independence.
The same measurable all-time event contains the true coefficient family in the known inverse-map row-ellipsoid region after literal exact integrated mass intersection.
Positive-definite design geometry and genuine weighted Cauchy-Schwarz with the actual inverse matrix give the stated directional coefficient-row error bound in every direction.
scope_limits: Conditional on a correct declared finite observation basis, known invertible test/basis integration matrix, exact accessible current/next state maps and actual conditional instrument law. No hidden-state recovery, basis discovery, excitation or coverage is inferred from regression success.

Sample, recorded-history and observation spaces are arbitrary measurable spaces. State coordinates, actions, basis tests and response rows are explicitly finite. No Standard Borel restriction is introduced.
Ordinary basis and basis-product integrability are explicit for the displayed operator and mass integrals. The compact polynomial-reference sector supplies them; no bounded-test surrogate is imposed.

P81 noise assumptions concern the actual row residual y minus true moment-row dot predictable design, with its ordinary conditional exponential bound. Declared positive noise scales, ridge values and Euclidean parameter bounds are retained.

Estimates and coefficient regions use the observed accessible states/responses and declared constants. Only the analysis Good event uses the unknown true row parameters, as in a usual confidence proof.
The mass-constrained region enforces the literal known integrated mass affine slice. Positivity and a full valid geometry for every candidate remain separate downstream questions.

The theorem supplies an explicit measurable Good event with probability at least1-delta and all finite-time coverage/directional conclusions on it. It does not infer model truth from nonrejection or claim an infinite-horizon shrinking rate.
No inherited proof source was edited. Parent cumulative integration/ancestry reconciliation and separate-agent raw review remain separate acceptance layers.

individual_checks.public_signature_check: No StandardBorelSpace or condExpKernel in printed main signatures.

boundary_meaning: A measurable normalized next-state map different from the positive identity-instrument posterior does not have the claimed operator moment. The first control rejects dropping the actual posterior/accessibility relation.

Two coefficient families produce exactly the same actual identity instrument under a repeated observation basis. Their known moment matrix is singular and they are distinct, so omitting W invertibility loses coefficient uniqueness.
The actual quarter-identity design gives weighted row norm one half for a direction with pairing one; dropping the inverse-design directional factor is false.
development_diagnostics: All unsuccessful elaboration/linter attempts are retained under development_logs. They are not accepted check evidence; the frozen six sources were all freshly checked in17 stages after the final clean individual compiles.
review_provenance: Author proof/checks. Nonauthor raw review requested from parent; same-team/model lineage is not external independent certification.
